summary: Bounded re-review of plan revision 2, interface version 2 and contract integration found no blocking defects. P-01 is resolved by an explicitly owned, required desktop boundary check with positive and negative fixtures. P-02 is resolved by applying and reading back the exact ask policy for initial and new sessions, blocking unverified execution, and specifying negative verification. D-03 is resolved by retaining the legacy runtimeSnapshot sessionId as non-authoritative while requiring main-registered IDs and ownership validation for workbench operations. The interface hash matches the contract. Gate ordering correctly requires recording the plan pass and registering the interface artifact before its separate design-spec review and dependent implementation.

provenance.evidence_limits: Read-only document re-review, exact plan review-input command and interface hash verification only. No edits, tests, SDK execution, delegation, credential access or design-spec binding request. This verdict approves the corrected plan, not completed implementation or the separate design-spec gate.
